title: pseudognaphalium antennarioides
intro: Pseudognaphalium antennarioides, commonly known as Purple Needle Grass, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pseudognaphalium antennarioides include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Purple Needle Grass include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
